managementTone.evidenceNotes: CEO Scott Strazik and CFO Ken Parks exhibited high conviction regarding demand inflections across Power and Electrification. They articulated precise metrics, highlighting 116 GW of gas turbine backlog and slot reservations (targeting 125 GW by year-end) and over $5B of data center orders in H1. Management proactively acknowledged the offshore wind EBITDA loss of -$275M and Vineyard Wind blade remediation costs, but firmly characterized them as ring-fenced legacy issues distinct from the surging core.

topTopics.topic: Heavy-duty gas turbine factory slot availability and production ramp through 2029
topTopics.managementResponse: Strong — Strazik confirmed production capacity is effectively booked through 2029 with disciplined pricing, selective contract terms, and customer reservation deposits.

topTopics.topic: Vineyard Wind litigation, Massachusetts court injunction, and offshore warranty remediation tail-risk
topTopics.managementResponse: Acknowledged — Parks confirmed $320M in incremental warranty reserves and noted ongoing structural testing at Gaspé while legal discussions continue.

topTopics.topic: Sustainability of Electrification segment margin expansion toward 15-18%
topTopics.managementResponse: Strong — Highlighted that pre-inflation fixed-price backlog has diminished significantly, allowing higher-margin Grid Solutions and HVDC contracts to flow through.

topTopics.topic: Hyperscaler data center direct 'behind-the-meter' gas power procurement models
topTopics.managementResponse: Strong — Described direct engagements with leading cloud providers deploying aeroderivatives and HA turbines as dedicated microgrid baseload.

topTopics.topic: Onshore wind margin inflection timeline and repowering conversion rates
topTopics.managementResponse: Confident — Outlined high single-digit margins on newly booked onshore turbines and clear demand visibility driven by IRA tax credit repowering.

keyQuotes.speaker: Scott Strazik
keyQuotes.quote: Demand for dispatchable power is at levels we have not witnessed in decades. Our gas turbine backlog and slot reservations reached 116 gigawatts this quarter, and we are confident in crossing at least 125 gigawatts by the end of 2026.
keyQuotes.context: Opening remarks on global utility demand and AI power constraints

keyQuotes.speaker: Scott Strazik
keyQuotes.quote: Data center orders exceeded $5 billion in the first six months of this year alone — more than doubling our full-year 2025 total. Hyperscalers simply cannot wait five to seven years for grid interconnections.
keyQuotes.context: Discussing Electrification order growth and cloud customer direct procurement

keyQuotes.speaker: Ken Parks
keyQuotes.quote: Our raised full-year guidance reflects expanding profitability in Power and Electrification, where pricing realization and productivity are driving substantial operating margin flow-through.
keyQuotes.context: Explaining the upward revision to FY2026 revenue and cash flow guidance

keyQuotes.speaker: Ken Parks
keyQuotes.quote: The Wind segment results reflect the challenging reality of burning through legacy offshore commitments and addressing blade remediation. We have ring-fenced these contracts, and our onshore business is already generating positive underlying margins.
keyQuotes.context: Addressing the Q2 Wind segment EBITDA loss of $275 million and warranty provisions
